params: @niko_wtf2 Why are you screaming so loud? You scared me!
@niko_wtf Okay, why do you announce so loudly?
[MY VOLUME IS SET TO MAXIMUM SO PEOPLE CAN BETTER HEAR MY ANNOUNCEMENTS!]
[I thought you were going to tell me it's announcing time again.]
@niko_speak It's okay, I just hope we didn't wake anyone up.
[She often tells me to can it, but I am not a canner bot, nor can I put announcements in a can!]
@niko_eyeclosed I don't think that's what she means...
@niko How did you just power on when I walked by you?
[It is a new mode I invented for passing non-announcing time, where I preserve energy, and time moves faster!]
[Sleep has a side effect. When you wake up, you are unpleasant and need to do a routine called "morning".]
[When I wake up from Standby, I am ready to go and announce the news immediately!]
@niko So what are you doing now?
[Waiting until I am allowed to announce again!]
@niko Are you always just waiting to announce the news?
[Sometimes I talk with my friends in the library, or the cafe.]
[And sometimes I watch the cats play in the alleys with another friend.]
[Do you also like playing in the alleys?]
@niko2 No! I'm trying to be sneaky!
[Aw, it would've been a great announcement...]
@niko_speak Fine, you call tell your friend from the alley.
[(Personal news, today is a good day!)]
